story.body: You stopped the potion after one pass under the note. Kemp did not add a line. Cowley asked for the word under a blot, and you told him the cues would be copied tonight. You left the apparel and the timing to Wednesday.

story.body: You cautioned yourself, in the margin, not to explain the sea. You did not write the tale out. You went to be the old father.

story.body: You mended the cues, left the speeches alone, and tied the strip. The thanks is the copy. It is not a share and not a price.
